messages:
marta: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a 'negotiation sidecar' at ingress that performs a lightweight capability handshake with clients (x-rw-client-cap) and rewrites requests/responses to the newest runtime shape when safe. Advantage: no immediate SDK churn.
drew: sounds promising. two high-level concerns: 1) negotiation correctness for intermittent clients, 2) perf/latency overhead.
yun: For correctness, handshake should be idempotent and cache per-connection for a short TTL (e.g., 60s). Use a signed capability token so we can trust cached entries.
priya: Telemetry requirements: count per-tenant transforms, schema_diff_rate, and transform_latency_ms. Also log mismatches to a small sample store for quick audits.
infra-bot: canary deploy queued: staging/negotiation-sidecar v0.0.1  rolling 2 nodes (ETA 2m)
sre-team: Operational note: sidecar must expose a tenant kill-switch and per-route circuit breaker. If transform fails or p99 latency > 250ms, route to compatibility runtime and increment shim.fallback counter.
drew: Implementation detail: prefer stateless mapping + ephemeral in-process cache. Avoid sticky sessions unless telemetry shows repeated handshakes causing thrash.
yun: Contract: sidecar only performs shape-preserving rewrites for these fields: `input`, `model`, `streaming` flags, and header mappings. No content-level rewrites other than wrapping v4-produced chat into v5 'responses' object.
priya: Add header `x-rw-negotiated: v4->v5` when transform applied. SDKs can surface a warning when they see it. Also add a Console view to toggle per-tenant opt-in.
sre-team: Test plan: golden prompts + fuzzed payloads, latency injects, and connection churn. Chaos scenario: clients that flip capabilities mid-stream.
marta: Rollout plan: internal dev tenants 3 days, canary 5% prod 48h, require schema_diff_rate < 0.05% and median latency delta < 15ms to proceed. If any tenant shows shim.fallback > 0.2% in canary, pause.
drew: Also add automated alerting for repeated idempotency failures (handshake mismatches) and a playbook entry for immediate rollback.
marta: Next steps: Yun to sketch token format and TTL, Priya to define telemetry events and dashboards, SRE to prepare kill-switch. We'll reconvene Thursday. Thanks all :sparkles:
